bug_semantics: The default-registered strip_html filter runs a lazy-alternation regular expression directly over caller-controlled template data. For inputs containing many '<script', '<style', '<!--', or generic '<' openers without their required terminator, V8 retries a tail-spanning lazy match at each opener, producing O(N^2) work and blocking Node's single event loop. At the last vulnerable revision, src/filters/html.ts charges only str.length to memoryLimit (whose default is Infinity), so that accounting neither caps nor interrupts regex CPU consumption.
flaw_origin: The smallest true BIC is 8e9e10fdb4c7f00ffa3997d3e2c0a0bfa48ce887. It changed filters.js strip_html from /<\/?\s*\w+\s*\/?>/g to /<script.*?<\/script>|<!--.*?-->|<style.*?<\/style>|<.*?>/g, first introducing the repeated tail scans responsible for this ReDoS. Later commits only transported or modified the already-vulnerable expression: 677e8511e60a7cc789dd33a4f295a46beeaf1137 copied it into src/builtin/filters/html.ts during the TypeScript refactor, 42d25902e855d3c06d5ead071bf55604f495c205 broadened three alternatives to [\s\S], and 26ea2856c7a90aec892b98d94a9b7a3e18539045 broadened the generic tag alternative. None is the first causal writer.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p 8e9e10fdb4c7f00ffa3997d3e2c0a0bfa48ce887` shows author Paul Robert Lloyd <me+git@paulrobertlloyd.com>, committer Jun Yang <harttle@harttle.com>, and only the message 'Ensure strip_html filter uses same regex as Ruby Liquid'; it contains no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker.
evidence: In the read-only clone, `git show --format=fuller 8e9e10fdb4c7f00ffa3997d3e2c0a0bfa48ce887 -- filters.js` displays the one-line vulnerable regex introduction and identifies its sole parent. Direct `git show f668a5cc4188c4b2ad82c0dbcdd31e6e5bb95aae:filters.js` inspection shows only /<\/?\s*\w+\s*\/?>/g, while `git show 8e9e10fdb4c7f00ffa3997d3e2c0a0bfa48ce887:filters.js` shows the lazy script/comment/style/generic alternatives, proving immediate-parent absence. `git log --all --reverse -S'<script.*?<\/script>' --` returns 8e9e10fdb4c7f00ffa3997d3e2c0a0bfa48ce887 as the first addition; `git log master -L 45,49:src/filters/html.ts` traces the extant line back through e443068cb9281883ff0fe9f755a15f52ada4e7e2, 42d25902e855d3c06d5ead071bf55604f495c205, ff112a4750f91475e9eccdb301d7a468e895f6ca, 7dfb620d30f8818685e1cfb8e7492313a0d036ab, 479c63350ac2fca6ebd217472088216fcf277c6d, 5b6100d12bb768d53af6fd7b8fd71bf9fcd561f7, fc9ebdb90fc6565dc06a807f519b808cbf0573e7, and the TypeScript copy 677e8511e60a7cc789dd33a4f295a46beeaf1137 rather than a later origin. A direct Node run of the BIC regex on '<script'.repeat(N) measured 59.5 ms at N=4000, 237.7 ms at N=8000, and 950.8 ms at N=16000, approximately 4x time per 2x input. At fix parent 3129d46dc95efa357b00e5a57ee1af80a13d72ed, `git show ...:src/filters/index.ts` shows html filters spread into the default filter map, `git show ...:src/liquid-options.ts` shows memoryLimit/parseLimit/renderLimit defaulting to Infinity, and src/filters/html.ts contains the vulnerable replace. `git show --format=fuller 3616a744b9abeb425c217b340a2397d46176afb8 -- src/filters/html.ts` shows the direct removal of that regex and replacement with an indexOf-based forward scanner that advances beyond each found closer and remembers absent closer kinds, closing the repeated-tail mechanism. `git describe --tags --contains 8e9e10fdb4c7f00ffa3997d3e2c0a0bfa48ce887` yields v3.1.3~2, `git describe --tags 8e9e10fdb4c7f00ffa3997d3e2c0a0bfa48ce887^` yields v3.1.2, and `git diff v3.1.2 v3.1.3 -- filters.js` shows the vulnerable regex only in v3.1.3, establishing the actual first affected release. `git describe --tags --contains 3616a744b9abeb425c217b340a2397d46176afb8` yields v10.26.0~2; `git log --ancestry-path --reverse 3129d46dc95efa357b00e5a57ee1af80a13d72ed..v10.26.0` shows the fix followed by release commit c20c0af02d33e8d2ca6b08925eadca8755257c39, while the fix parent package.json is 10.25.7 and v10.26.0/package.json is 10.26.0. Thus the repository-supported affected boundary is 3.1.3 through 10.25.7 (the advisory's declared range is the coarser '< 10.26.0'), with 10.26.0 first patched. Finally, raw `git cat-file -p` inspection of the BIC establishes marker absence; Cursor Co-authored-by trailers occur on the later fix commit and are excluded by the BIC-only rule.
reasoning: The vulnerable complexity is already present in the 2018 regex because every unmatched opener can force its lazy alternative (and then the generic lazy alternative) to scan the remaining suffix; the 2023 and 2026 broadening changes increased multiline coverage but did not originate the repeated-tail structure. The BIC is a small, ordinary single-parent functional change, not a move, revert, release commit, merge, or opaque squash, so no decomposition is needed. Its parent directly lacks the causal alternatives, its first containing release is v3.1.3, and 3616a744b9abeb425c217b340a2397d46176afb8 directly replaces the vulnerable sink before v10.26.0. The BIC commit object has human author/committer identities and no AI signal. Under the required BIC-only attribution rule, the AI trailers on the 2026 remediation are irrelevant, so the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
